Bulk stationery packaging from Vapi for pen gift sets, marker collections, premium writing instrument gift boxes, and stationery brand seasonal gifting programmes. As a stationery gift set packaging manufacturer from India, we supply APET and PETG gift set trays for domestic retail and export stationery programmes.

Stationery gift set trays are a brand communication platform — the moment the gift box is opened reveals the pen set or marker collection arrayed in the tray in its brand-intended presentation. PETG premium clarity for luxury writing instrument brands. APET crystal-clear for mid-range stationery gift sets. Each writing instrument must be in its correct position, label visible, and the colour arrangement must follow the brand's gift display specification.

sections.st: Three Problems Stationery Gift Set Trays Buyers Face

strips.title: Gift Set Presentation Failure — Items Not in Brand-Intended Positions
strips.desc: Problem: Stationery gift set trays where items are not in the brand-intended presentation positions create a disordered opening experience — pens in wrong positions, colour sequence broken. Solution: Gift set tray cavity designed from the brand's intended gift arrangement. Physical placement confirmed on prototype before production tooling.

strips.title: Clarity Below Brand Standard — Standard APET for Premium Writing Instrument Gift
strips.desc: Problem: Luxury pen brands using standard APET trays have their premium positioning undermined — the packaging material communicates standard, not luxury. Solution: PETG for luxury writing instrument gift set trays — superior clarity communicates the premium brand positioning.

strips.title: Height Variation in Stationery Gift Sets — Mixed Items at Different Heights
strips.desc: Problem: Stationery gift sets containing tall items (30cm ruler, 17cm markers) alongside short items (5cm eraser, 8cm lipstick pens) create extreme height variation. Solution: Height variation management through product grouping and fill platforms for short items.

sections.st: Stationery Gift Set Trays — Key Design Requirements

strips.title: Label-Visible Orientation — Every Writing Instrument Faces the Consumer
strips.desc: Each pen, marker, and writing instrument cavity designed with label-visible orientation — branded face facing the consumer at the correct viewing angle. Confirmed from physical products before tooling.

strips.title: APET vs PETG Selection — Brand Tier Communication
strips.desc: APET for mid-range stationery gift sets — crystal clarity at OEM cost efficiency. PETG for luxury writing instrument brands — superior clarity communicates premium positioning.

strips.title: Height Variation Management — Mixed Stationery Item Heights
strips.desc: Gift sets containing rulers, markers, and small stationery items at extreme height differences — managed through product grouping by height and fill platforms for short items.

strips.title: Colour Arrangement Display — Brand Colour Sequence Layout
strips.desc: Marker and highlighter gift set trays designed with colour cavity positions matching the brand's intended colour sequence display — rainbow sequence, complementary colour pairs, or brand colour family grouping.
